compareDisposition.rationale: No distinct two-source pairing adds more than this passage and its existing Scripture connections.

observations.body: Moses led Israel onward from the Red Sea, and they went out into the wilderness of Shur; and they went three days in the wilderness, and found no water.
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: Israel enters the wilderness of Shur and finds no water for three days.
observations.label: From song to thirst

observations.body: Three days without water turn the wilderness of Shur into a crisis after the sea crossing.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Exodus 15:20–24 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: Recent deliverance stands beside immediate complaint when the water cannot be drunk.
payload.title: Three days without water
